title: Permit suspension or revocation.
officialText:
The commissioner is authorized to suspend or revoke a permit issued under this appendix
wherever the permit is issued in error or on the basis of incorrect, inaccurate or incomplete information, or in violation of this code,
in accordance with Section 28-105.
SECTION BC G105
PROGRESS AND SPECIAL INSPECTION REQUIREMENTS
